$comment: This schema validates the v1 wire shape only. Consumers MUST reject an unsupported format or version before resolution. Semantic resolution additionally enforces that contribution IDs are source-derived and unique and that ordinal values are contiguous zero-based integers in source order; JSON Schema cannot express either cross-item invariant.

actorDeclareContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers to the net annotation actors: one {name, kind} entry per actor, in source order.

arcColor.$comment: Both explicit-color syntax and bare -> lower to an explicitly chosen core color. Bare -> uses the generic core color token.

transitionNameSpan.$comment: Required only for a consumed place-to-transition declaration; identifies the exact lexical transition-name token.

arcIds.$comment: Ordered source ArcIds in the handle's consecutive expansion run.

arcHandleTarget.$comment: A typed local source @handle reference. It may precede its topology declaration; the resolver later resolves its ordered ArcId mapping and requires exactly one compatible concrete arc when an elaboration needs one.

arcId.$comment: The deterministic source-derived identity of an arc.declare contribution. It is never a canonical JSON arc index.

colorTarget.$comment: A token color named by a decoration. The resolver requires some place to accept it.

compositionFinalContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for composition documents, where it lowers to the composition's final markings; every alias must be declared by a use fact. One contribution per final fact; each marking lists places that must all hold a token.

value.$comment: The namespace is DSL-local source identity only. It MUST NOT lower to a core composition name, description, annotations, or other composition metadata.

compositionRefineContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for composition documents; both aliases must be declared by use facts and differ.

span.$comment: The exact half-open span of the authored refining alias.
The exact half-open span of the authored alias-dot-transition endpoint.

compositionShareContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for composition documents; every alias must be declared by a use fact. A share has no direction: its places need not be ports.

compositionUseContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for composition documents and resolves ref relative to the containing source.

compositionWireContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for composition documents and validates output-to-input direction and equal port colors.

contribution.$comment: The oneOf is deliberately closed: every kind has an exact typed target and exact value structure. No generic target or arbitrary host-language value is permitted.

contributionIdentity.$comment: Deterministically derived from the source document, source statement, and expanded statement part. It is not a runtime-generated UUID.

decorationBesideContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].decorations. Only a place annotated fusion true has local copies to place.

decorationHighlightContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].decorations. Presentation only.

decorationNoteContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].decorations. Presentation only.

decorationQuietContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].decorations. Presentation only.

decorationShowContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].decorations. Names the token fields a renderer shows for a color, in source order.

items.$comment: A token field path: non-empty keys joined by dots. A dotted path reaches into a nested object.

decorationSingleContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].decorations. Only a place annotated fusion true is drawn as local copies, so only that place has a fused drawing to collapse to one node.

decorationSummaryContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].decorations. Only transitions and arcs carry expressions to summarize.

domainValuesContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers to the net's domains member under the key color.path. The engine enforces it (ADR 0037).

path.$comment: A token field path: non-empty keys joined by dots.

extensionsContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].extensions.

namedMarkingContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].markings.

netDocumentTarget.$comment: The typed top-level net target for ordinary net description and annotation facts. Composition has no corresponding ordinary core metadata target.

proofFinalContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers to proofs.final. One contribution per final marking: the target is its first place, and `with` lists the other places that must also hold a token.

proofInvariantContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers to proofs.invariants.

relativePosition.$comment: Authored relative view position: the rendered subject is offset from 'from' by 'delta'. The resolver checks shape and target references here, requires a place position for a bare place base and a copy position for a place-copy base, and resolves the chain at render time (ADR 0024).

relativeSourceId.$comment: A logical source-relative identifier. The resolver, not this schema, verifies that it is relative to the loading root and identifies an available source.

span.$comment: A half-open source span. start and end refer to the same UTF-8 source; end MUST NOT precede start. Equality with the containing contribution id.source is enforced by the resolver.

taggedJsonValue.description: A closed lossless representation of an RFC 8259 JSON value. Objects use ordered entries so object-entry order and number lexemes survive target-neutral reconstruction.

taggedNumber.$comment: The resolver MUST parse lexeme as a finite IEEE-754 binary64 value. Integer lexemes MUST be in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]. These numeric-profile checks cannot be expressed portably in JSON Schema.

entries.$comment: Entries are retained in source order. The resolver rejects duplicate keys.

viewDetailContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents. It sets the label detail level a renderer uses when it applies the view.

viewFusionContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents, where it lowers below annotations['petrinet.dsl/v1'].views. It chooses whether that view draws one fusion place as a single node or as per-transition copies.

viewPositionContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents and validates position as the v1 {x:number,y:number} value or the v1 additive relative {from,delta} shape.

viewRouteContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents and validates each point as the v1 {x:number,y:number} value.

viewSplinesContribution.$comment: Resolver accepts this kind only for net documents. It sets the Graphviz edge style a renderer uses when it applies the view.

span.$comment: The exact half-open span of the authored alias-dot-place endpoint.

description: A portable, progressive, target-neutral intermediate representation for .petrinet source documents.

contributions.$comment: Items MUST have unique source-derived id values and ordinal values 0..length-1 without gaps, ordered by ordinal.

format.description: The only supported IR format identifier.

version.description: The only supported IR format version.
